name: honduras-payroll
description: Use this skill to run Honduras payroll for employees in 2026. It covers the employer's monthly ISR withholding on the SAR 2026 progressive scale (exempt to L228,324.32 a year), the remittance of retentions within 10 calendar days of the following month, the 13th month (aguinaldo) and 14th month salaries with their ISR exemption of 10 average minimum wages each (L149,172.00 in 2026), the 2026 minimum wage table of Acuerdo SETRASS-233-2026 (average L14,917.20 a month) and the employee's annual position. IHSS and RAP rates live in honduras-social-contributions. Trigger phrases include planilla Honduras, retencion ISR asalariados codigo 111, aguinaldo, decimo cuarto mes, salario minimo 2026 Honduras and net salary Honduras.
